caption: The drawing displays an eight-pointed star constructed from diamond-shaped segments arranged symmetrically to form the overall star shape. Each of the star’s points is composed of three distinct strips: one is beige with a vertical, flowery vine pattern in red, green, and dark brown, another is mostly blue with a wavy pattern and simple red and white accents, and the third has a red and pink floral pattern with green leaves against a light background. The strips are bordered by scalloped or wavy lines in blue and red. The background of the drawing is a plain off-white or cream color, and a faint rectangular dashed or dotted outline surrounds the star, indicating a boundary or framing guide for the composition. There are no other objects or elements in the image aside from the bordered star and its outlined frame.
title: Quilt Applique (Stars)
